An exclusive by Shyamlal Yadav of The Indian Express highlights major transparency gaps in the Immovable Property Returns (IPRs) filed by India's top bureaucrats. Out of 244 self-acquired properties reviewed across 102 top officials (Secretary-level central officers and state/UT Chief Secretaries), 115 properties did not list any size, area, or dimensions.
